commands.example:
fui security add "VWCE ETF" --kind etf --ticker VWCE --currency EUR
  fui security add Bitcoin --kind crypto --ticker BTC --currency EUR

flags.name: kind
flags.usage: security kind: stock, etf, bond, fund or crypto

flags.name: quantity-scale
flags.usage: quantity decimals (default: 8 for crypto, 0 for others)

commands.short: Set a manual price for a security
commands.example:
fui security price VWCE 127.35 --date 2026-03-01
  fui security price BTC 95000 --json
